title: --text-env returns env_not_set — pass the variable name, not the value
symptom: web type · app type end with env_not_set ("Environment variable … is empty")
cause: --text-env takes an environment variable name. No variable with that name is in the launch_cli process environment: the value itself was passed, or it was set in another Bash call and is gone (Bash resets on every call)
fix: Prefix it on the same command line: CODE=<value> launch_cli.py web type --selector <box> --text-env CODE
The command line stays in the session record — pass only values that may stay there this way, such as one-time codes
For a saved login, do not handle the value; use --cred <name> (the value never reaches the command line or records)
